# orchestra_pipeline (Data Source)

A single pipeline, looked up by ID, alias, or repository and YAML path. Supply exactly one selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a pipeline up by alias or ID.
data "orchestra_pipeline" "daily_sales" {
  alias = "daily_sales"
}

output "daily_sales_last_run" {
  value = data.orchestra_pipeline.daily_sales.latest_run_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) The pipeline alias.
- `branch` (String) Read from a specific branch, for git-backed pipelines.
- `commit` (String) Read from a specific commit, for git-backed pipelines.
- `id` (String) The pipeline ID. Supply it as a selector, or read it back from another selector.
- `repository` (String) Repository holding the definition. Must be supplied together with `yaml_path`.
- `version` (Number) Read a specific saved version rather than the current one.
- `yaml_path` (String) Path to the pipeline YAML file. Must be supplied together with `repository`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the pipeline was created.
- `default_branch` (String) Default branch of the repository.
- `inputs` (Attributes Map) Declared runtime inputs, keyed by input name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inputs))
- `latest_run_completed_at` (String) When the most recent run completed.
- `latest_run_created_at` (String) When the most recent run was created.
- `latest_run_id` (String) ID of the most recent run.
- `latest_run_message` (String) Message from the most recent run.
- `latest_run_started_at` (String) When the most recent run started.
- `latest_run_status` (String) Status of the most recent run.
- `latest_version_number` (Number) Highest saved version number.
- `name` (String) The pipeline name.
- `num_tasks` (Number) Number of tasks in the pipeline.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is paused.
- `product_id` (String) Product the pipeline belongs to.
- `product_name` (String) Name of that product.
- `published_version_number` (Number) Version number currently published.
- `schedule` (String) Summary of the pipeline's schedules.
- `sensors` (String) Summary of the pipeline's sensors.
- `storage_provider` (String) Where the definition lives: ORCHESTRA or a git provider.
- `trigger_events` (String) Summary of the pipeline's trigger events.
- `updated_at` (String) When the pipeline was last updated.
- `webhook` (String) Summary of the pipeline's webhook trigger.

<a id="nestedatt--inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inputs`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Default value, JSON-encoded.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the input may be omitted.
- `type` (String) Data type of the input.
